field_edits.updated_text: There is straightening of the normal cervical lordosis. The spinal alignment is maintained without evidence of spondylolisthesis.
Vertebral body heights are maintained. Mild disc space narrowing is present at C6-C7 with mild multilevel degenerative endplate changes and small anterior osteophytes.
No prevertebral soft tissue swelling is demonstrated.

impression:
1. Straightening of the normal cervical lordosis.
2. Mild multilevel cervical spondylosis, greatest at C6-C7.
3. No acute osseous abnormality.
